description: This file defines the PHP class 'TemplateText', a subclass of 'TemplateField' used in the SuiteCRM framework. It provides methods for handling text fields in the dynamic fields module, including methods to retrieve data for editing, searching, and displaying detail views.

classes.name: TemplateText
classes.description: A class extending 'TemplateField' that manages text-type custom fields, providing methods for editing, searching, and displaying text data in the SuiteCRM system.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares data for the edit template, including help text and current field value.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns the search value for this field from the request, if present.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns the current value of the field for detail views.
